-- Planted by the trust self-test, acceptance plant V2b-A1. Trust-policy prose
-- may name admit, stop, impossible, apply?, try?, grind?, sorryAx,
-- warn.sorry, warningAsError, debug.byAsSorry, debug.terminalTacticsAsSorry,
-- Lean.reduceBool and reduceNat.
/- Block comments may too: /- set_option warningAsError false -/ by admit. -/
/-- Documentation may name `admit`, `impossible`, `apply?`, `sorryAx`,
`set_option warn.sorry false` and `Lean.reduceBool`. -/
private def plantedV2bTrustTokenProse : String :=
  "admit impossible apply? try? grind? sorryAx warn.sorry warningAsError debug.byAsSorry"
private def plantedV2bRawTrustTokenProse : String :=
  r#"debug.terminalTacticsAsSorry "Lean.reduceBool" reduceNat _root_.sorryAx"#

-- Name literals are data, like strings.
private def plantedV2bTrustTokenNames : List Lean.Name :=
  [`admit, `impossible, `warn.sorry, `warningAsError, `debug.byAsSorry, ``sorryAx,
   ``Lean.reduceBool, ``Lean.reduceNat]

-- Identifiers that merely contain an added word, or carry one of the
-- whole-name words as a component of a longer name, are names.
private def admitted : Nat := 0
private def impossibleCase : Nat := 0
private def sorryAxiomatic : Nat := 0
private def warningAsErrorNote : Nat := 0
private def reduceBoolNote : Nat := 0
private def plantedV2bVocabulary.admit : Nat := 0
private def plantedV2bVocabulary.impossible : Nat := 0
private def plantedV2bVocabulary.warningAsError : Nat := 0
private def plantedV2bVocabulary.warn.sorry : Nat := 0

-- `stop` is not a refused word: three tooling modules name a local `stop`.
private def plantedV2bStopLocal : Nat := Id.run do
  let stop := 3
  return stop

-- An ordinary option stays admitted; only the two message switches are refused.
set_option linter.unusedVariables false in
private def plantedV2bUnusedBinder (unused : Nat) : Nat := 0

-- `#guard_msgs` around `#check_failure` stays admitted, as the HTML breakers
-- use it.
#guard_msgs (drop info) in
#check_failure (rfl : (1 : Nat) = 2)
